items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and reject all new dispatches, spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, with 225 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The pilot's 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal evidence; treatment also had 58 requests versus 40 and a longer 12.21-hour cycle versus 9.39. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation, repair, measurement, attribution, legal, and security work. Minimum measurement before reconsidering growth: attributable revenue by site/content/tracking ID for the same cost period; complete AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost ledger; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with maximum cost-to-learn.

Retain the four candidate proposals as deferred hypotheses only. Do not queue or requeue the three proposed site changes. Traffic, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, AI usage, SEO impressions, and output counts do not establish contribution margin, ROI, payback, or causal lift.
